content.text: The data shows that zone occupancy-period setpoint changed from ~24.4°C to ~23.4°C in the same period the zone air temperature dropped ~0.8°C. Both shift together, only in occupied hours — consistent with a schedule change rather than a local override (which would shift the zone temp without the zone-level commanded cooling setpoint changing, and would typically persist across all hours).
